dogecoin.text: @neonlights214 I know literally nothing about Dogecoin other than it's another form of crypto. I'm not investing in Bitcoin and don't know much about it tbh, but I know friends who are.

It's pretty dumb to invest $250k in a meme cryptocurrency in the first place though. And if you're not selling, then you're not really a multi-millionaire cuz all that money is virtual. It could disappear overnight if the value of Dogecoin tumbles like what happened with Bitcoin.
